songs.title: Now and Yesterday ⏰
lines: Right now I am playing tag,
playing tag, playing tag.
Right now I am playing tag.
I played it yesterday!
We had a pillow fight last night,
pillow fight, pillow fight.
We had a pillow fight last night,
but we did not play tag!
n: 곡조: Mary Had a Little Lamb (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
'right now'에서는 손가락으로 아래(지금)를, 'yesterday'·'last night'에서는 엄지로 어깨 뒤(과거)를 가리켜요.
songs.imgPrompt: Two scenes side by side: kids playing tag in a sunny park, and the same kids laughing in a pillow fight in pajamas at night.

songs.title: I Visited My Grandma 👵
lines: I visited my grandma
just one week ago!
I rode a train, and she made soup,
yum, yum, yum, yum, yum!
We saw a movie, and I met my aunt,
I rode, I saw, I met, and I hugged them all!
I visited my grandma
just one week ago!
n: 곡조: Old MacDonald Had a Farm (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
rode(기차 칙칙폭폭), saw(눈 위에 손 올리기), met(손 흔들기), hugged(자기 몸 꼭 안기) 동작을 과거형 낱말마다 해요.
songs.imgPrompt: A happy child hugging a smiling grandmother and an aunt in a cozy kitchen with a pot of soup, a toy train on the table.

songs.title: Where Did You Go? ✈️
lines: I flew on a plane to Japan.
The trip was two hours long!
I sailed on a ship to Jeju.
Splash! It was not long!
Where did you go? Where did you go?
I went to the Philippines!
I flew there from Korea.
Wow! The trip was long!
n: 곡조: Pop Goes the Weasel (저작권 만료 곡) — 가사는 이 단원 낱말로 새로 지었습니다
flew(두 팔 벌려 비행기), sailed(두 손으로 노 젓기) 동작을 하고, 'Splash!'·'Wow!'에서 두 손을 번쩍 들어요.
songs.imgPrompt: Children traveling on a world map adventure, one flying in a small plane over the sea and another waving from a ship sailing to a green island.
